sources.detail: Claude build — board sign-off through 7 revisions (r1-r7, 2026-05-20). Thesis: Ur-Dragon Eminence ({1} discount on OTHER Dragon spells) hits every changeling because changelings are every creature type incl. Dragon. One Sliver/Elemental/Elf changeling triggers Sliver/Elemental/Elf payoffs simultaneously. 13 changelings + 6 Slivers + 4 dragons + commander = high tribal density across multiple axes.

guideContent.strategyOverview:
The Ur-Dragon is a {4}{W}{U}{B}{R}{G} 10/10 Legendary Dragon Avatar with Eminence: as long as the commander is in the command zone or on the battlefield, OTHER Dragon spells you cast cost {1} less to cast. The deck's central insight: changelings are every creature type, INCLUDING Dragon. Every changeling spell triggers Eminence (saves {1}). Every changeling counts as a Dragon, Sliver, Elf, Wolf, Goblin, and Elemental on the stack and battlefield — meaning one Universal Automaton ({1}, 1/1) triggers Sliver lords, Elf-ramp dorks, Dragon attack triggers, Wolf draw triggers, and Elemental ETBs simultaneously.

The Eminence stacks with Dragonlord's Servant (-{1} more for Dragons) and Morophon, the Boundless (chosen type Dragon → -{WUBRG} colored mana on Dragon spells). With Morophon out, every changeling costs {1} or less. Ur-Dragon's printed cost is {4WUBRG} = 9 mana (Eminence doesn't apply to self — 'other Dragon spells'); with Morophon out it costs {4} = 4 mana, castable T5-T6 with our 6 spell-ramp + 4 Elf-ramp dorks + Sol Ring.

The attack trigger is the headline: 'Whenever 1+ Dragons attack, draw N + put a permanent from hand into play for free.' Every changeling attacking = a Dragon attack. 5 changelings + commander attacking = draw 6 + free permanent drop.

Win conditions: (1) Primary combat — Sliver Legion turns the board into a +N/+N alpha strike on full board (24 Slivers including changelings = +23/+23 to each). Sylvia Brightspear adds double strike to every Dragon (= every changeling). Atarka adds double strike on attack. Cloudshredder Sliver grants flying + haste. (2) Dragon Tempest + Scourge of Valkas scaling burn — every changeling ETB = X damage where X = Dragons in play. With 20+ Dragons, each new changeling pings for 20+. (3) Voja, Jaws of the Conclave swing — every changeling is an Elf AND a Wolf → on attack, +N counters board-wide + draw N. (4) Snoop+Kiki+Tremors back-door combo (~20% of games): Worldly Tutor → Kiki on top → Snoop in play has Kiki's static activated ability → tap Snoop to make a token copy of Snoop with haste, which also has Kiki's ability → infinite hasty Snoop tokens → Impact Tremors closes (or just attack for lethal). Self-contained 3-piece, disruptable at each node. (5) Champion of the Path Elemental ETB damage to each opponent.

Mana base is 37 lands (5-color, no fetches — Triomes + shocks + painlands + Path of Ancestry + Cavern of Souls + Boseiju + Bonders' Enclave). Cavern of Souls names Dragon → uncounterable commander + real dragons + every changeling. Bloom Tender taps for one of each color of permanents on board (= 5-color fixing once we deploy). Manaweft Sliver makes every changeling a mana dork.

Recovery layer: Patriarch's Bidding ({3BB}) names Dragon → all our changelings + dragons + Morophon return from each GY. Combined with Phyrexian Arena (unconditional 1 draw/turn) the deck rebuilds quickly after wraths.

3 Game Changers at bracket-3 ceiling: Worldly Tutor (combo enabler), Cyclonic Rift (asymmetric bounce wipe), Smothering Tithe (Treasure + draw-tax). No fetchlands, no fast mana (per board constraints — no Mana Crypt / Mana Vault / Force / The One Ring / Demonic / Vampiric).

highlights.name: The Ur-Dragon
highlights.reason: Commander — {4WUBRG} 10/10 flying Dragon Avatar. Eminence: OTHER Dragon spells cost {1} less from command zone or battlefield (does NOT apply to itself). Attack trigger: when 1+ Dragons attack, draw N + put a permanent from hand into play for free. Every changeling is a Dragon, so Eminence reduces every changeling spell and the attack trigger fires on every changeling swing.

highlights.name: Morophon, the Boundless
highlights.reason: {7} colorless 6/6 Legendary Shapeshifter w/ Changeling. ETB choose type (Dragon): spells of chosen type cost {WUBRG} less (colored mana only) + Dragon anthem. Reduces Ur-Dragon from 9 → 4 mana. Every changeling spell becomes cheaper (free or near-free).

highlights.name: Sliver Legion
highlights.reason: {WUBRG} 5/5 Legendary Sliver. All Sliver creatures get +1/+1 for each OTHER Sliver. With 24 Slivers (real Slivers + every changeling), every Sliver becomes 24/24+ — instant alpha-strike finisher.

highlights.name: Dragon Tempest
highlights.reason: {1R} enchantment. Every Dragon ETB deals X damage to any target where X = Dragons in play. Every changeling is a Dragon → every changeling ETB triggers X damage. Late-game with 15+ Dragons in play, each new changeling pings for 15+. Scales to lethal across the table.

highlights.name: Cavern of Souls
highlights.reason: Land — name Dragon at ETB. Mana spent from it on Dragon creature spells makes them uncounterable. Covers ~24 of our creatures (commander + 4 real dragons + 13 changelings + Morophon + Sliver Overlord via every-type when Maskwood is out). Protects the 9-mana commander from countermagic.

highlights.name: Patriarch's Bidding
highlights.reason: {3BB} sorcery. Each player names a creature type; each player returns all creatures of that type from their GY. Name Dragon → all our changelings + real dragons + Morophon return. Opps in non-tribal decks typically get nothing. Canonical wipe-rebuild tool for tribal decks.

highlights.name: Sylvia Brightspear
highlights.reason: {2W} 2/2 double strike. Static: 'Dragons your team controls have double strike.' Every changeling is a Dragon → every changeling double-strikes. With Sliver Legion pump, the alpha-strike kill turn ends games in one attack step.

highlights.name: Conspicuous Snoop
highlights.reason: {RR} 2/2 Goblin Rogue. 'Play with top of library revealed. As long as top is a Goblin card, this has all activated abilities of that card.' With Kiki-Jiki on top (via Worldly Tutor), Snoop has 'T: token copy of nonlegendary creature you control with haste'. Tap Snoop to copy itself → token Snoop also has Kiki's ability statically → infinite hasty Snoop tokens. Combo wins with Impact Tremors or alpha-attack.

highlights.name: Worldly Tutor
highlights.reason: Game Changer #1 of 3 at B3 ceiling. {G} instant — search for creature, put on top of library. Single tutor in the deck that can put Kiki-Jiki on top to enable the Snoop combo line. Also finds key threats (Sliver Legion, Lathliss, Risen Reef).

highlights.name: Cyclonic Rift
highlights.reason: Game Changer #2. {1U} instant bounce one nonland; overload {6U} bounces ALL nonlands you don't control. Asymmetric wipe-on-our-terms — the best non-destruction wipe in 5-color commander.

highlights.name: Smothering Tithe
highlights.reason: Game Changer #3. {3W} enchantment. Whenever opp draws, that player may pay {2} or you get a Treasure. Massive ramp + draw-tax in multiplayer.

winConditions.title: Sliver Legion alpha-strike (primary combat)
winConditions.description: With ~24 Slivers on board (13 changelings + 6 real Slivers + Sliver Overlord + Maskwood tokens), Sliver Legion pumps every Sliver by +23/+23. Sylvia grants double strike to all Dragons (= changelings). Cloudshredder grants flying+haste to all Slivers. Single attack step deals 600+ trample/flying combat damage. Sinew + Predatory anthems and Vanquisher's Banner stack further.

winConditions.title: Dragon Tempest scaling burn (secondary)
winConditions.description: Every Dragon ETB triggers Dragon Tempest for X damage = Dragons in play. With 15+ Dragons (changelings count) + Lathliss adding a 5/5 Dragon token per non-token Dragon ETB, casting one changeling = 15+ damage + a new 5/5 (which itself counts as a Dragon, recurring the chain on its arrival). Scourge of Valkas duplicates the effect. Chain pings the table from 40 → 0.

winConditions.title: Voja attack burst (tertiary)
winConditions.description: Voja attacks: +N counters to all our creatures (N = Elves) + draw N (N = Wolves). Every changeling is both an Elf and a Wolf, so with 8 changelings on board, +8/+8 board-wide AND draw 8 cards on attack. Sets up the alpha-strike same turn or next.

winConditions.title: Snoop+Kiki+Tremors combo (back-door, ~20% games)
winConditions.description: Worldly Tutor → Kiki-Jiki on top of library. Snoop in play has all activated abilities of top Goblin card → Snoop gains 'T: token copy of nonlegendary creature you control with haste, sacrifice EOT'. Tap Snoop to make a token copy of Snoop — the token also has Kiki's ability statically. Infinite hasty Snoop tokens. Impact Tremors deals 1 to each opp per ETB → infinite damage. Without Tremors: lethal attack via infinite hasty bodies. 3-piece contained line, opps can disrupt at each node (kill Snoop, counter Kiki, remove Tremors).

winConditions.title: Champion of the Path Elemental burn
winConditions.description: {3R} 7/3 Elemental. Whenever another Elemental ETBs, it deals damage equal to its power to each opponent. Every changeling is an Elemental → every changeling ETB triggers Champion. With Sinew + Predatory anthems and Sliver Legion pump, even 1/1 changelings become 4/4+ → 4+ damage to each opp per ETB.

synergies.title: Eminence + every changeling
synergies.description: Ur-Dragon's Eminence reduces 'other Dragon spells' by {1}. Every changeling (and Nameless Inversion as Kindred Instant Shapeshifter) counts as a Dragon spell on the stack. The discount stacks with Dragonlord's Servant and Morophon for free / near-free changelings.

synergies.title: Manaweft Sliver + every changeling = 5-color board fixing
synergies.description: Manaweft grants 'T: Add one mana of any color' to all Sliver creatures. Changelings ARE Slivers. With 5+ changelings on board, every creature can tap for any color — broken mana fixing equivalent to dual lands stapled to creatures.

synergies.title: Risen Reef chain on every changeling ETB
synergies.description: Risen Reef triggers on every Elemental ETB (changelings are Elementals). Each changeling cast → look top, play land or draw. Stacks per Reef. With Maskwood out, real Slivers/Dragons also trigger Reef. Free draws / land drops every turn cycle.

synergies.title: Lathliss + every changeling = free 5/5 Dragon token
synergies.description: Lathliss creates a 5/5 flying Dragon token per non-token Dragon ETB. Every changeling is a non-token Dragon → every changeling cast generates a free 5/5 Dragon token. Tokens trigger Dragon Tempest, Sliver Legion pump, Vanquisher's Banner anthem.

synergies.title: Voja Elf+Wolf double-count via changelings
synergies.description: Voja's attack trigger gives +N counters per Elf AND draws N cards per Wolf. Every changeling is both — single creature double-counts. With 6 changelings + Voja attacking = +6/+6 to everyone + draw 6 cards.

synergies.title: Cavern of Souls names Dragon → ~24 uncounterable
synergies.description: Naming Dragon at Cavern's ETB makes mana spent from it produce uncounterable Dragon spells. Covers commander (Dragon Avatar) + 4 real dragons + 13 changelings (every-type) + Morophon. Single name → ~24 of 33 creatures protected.

synergies.title: Snoop + Kiki + Worldly Tutor combo
synergies.description: Worldly Tutor → Kiki on top → Snoop gains Kiki's tap ability statically → infinite Snoop tokens with haste. Impact Tremors closes (1 dmg per ETB) or alpha-strike. Single point of failure: only Worldly Tutor enables (sole top-of-lib creature tutor in deck).

synergies.title: Patriarch's Bidding + Stinging Study (future r8) recovery
synergies.description: After a board wipe: turn N → cast Patriarch's Bidding ({3BB}) naming Dragon → all changelings + real dragons + Morophon return from GY. Single-card rebuild for the entire tribal engine.

synergies.title: Hatchery Sliver replicates every changeling spell
synergies.description: Hatchery Sliver static: 'Each Sliver spell you cast has replicate. Replicate cost = its mana cost.' Every changeling spell is a Sliver spell (every-type via Changeling), so every changeling we cast can be copied for an additional cost. Pay the replicate to duplicate ETB triggers — Risen Reef fires twice, Dragon Tempest fires twice, Lathliss makes 2 tokens, Vanquisher's Banner draws twice. Legendary spells (Sliver Legion/Hivelord/Overlord/Morophon) hit the legend rule on copies — skip replicate on those.

synergies.title: Thrumming Hivepool Affinity + Sliver static buffs
synergies.description: Thrumming Hivepool's Affinity for Slivers reduces its cost by {1} per Sliver controlled (counting every changeling as a Sliver). With ~6+ Slivers on board, Hivepool is effectively free. Static grants double strike + haste to all Slivers (covers real Slivers that Sylvia's Dragon-only double-strike misses). 2 free 1/1 Sliver tokens per upkeep stack with Sliver Legion pump.
